title: Number Garden
summary: A paper-cut garden where children grow plants by building and splitting numbers within 20.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop works at 390x844 (verified live): stacked plots, tap + stepper interaction. Drag precision is lower than tablet — steppers remain the primary input on small screens.

cover.alt: Staged success moment: a make-10 question answered — 7 seeds and 3 seeds planted in two soil beds, ten-frame full, green 'Đúng rồi! 7 và 3 ghép lại thành 10.' feedback strip

desktop.alt: Honest default landing: lesson-select with four staggered paper-cut garden beds (Đếm Hạt, Ghép 10, Cộng, Bốc Hạt) and their tree illustrations

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view of the play screen: question banner, two soil beds with seeds, seed-bag dock with steppers and ten-frame on a rolling paper hill

mobile.alt: Honest mobile landing: lesson-select garden beds stacked vertically at 390px width
